execution_mode: Causal Observation Engine / Modeling (Zero Backtesting / No PnL)

decision_framework.description: M1-U (Structural Path History) captures >98% of all learnable predictive signal over baseline. Adding prospective strength features (M2-U) and observed P90 state (M3-U) yields zero incremental OOS AUC lift (-0.0001 on both heads). M1-U is selected as the parsimonious Universal Regime Health Model.
